links.outcome: Patient comprehension quiz score for AI plain-language MRI report versus standard radiologist report
links.effect: AI group scored 20% higher than standard MRI group on comprehension quiz (74.7% vs 54.7%, P < .001); 87.5% preferred AI translation; clarity 4.5 vs 2.2 of 5.
links.quote: Patients in the AI group scored 20% higher than those in the standard MRI group on the comprehension quiz (74.7% vs 54.7%, P < .001).

screen.reason: This is a randomized trial testing the direct effect of providing an AI (ChatGPT-4) translated radiology report versus a standard radiology report to patients on their comprehension and trust, evaluating the base application rather than comparing a specific deployment safeguard/practice.
